question: Should the experimental Claw package contract adopt `CLAW.md` YAML frontmatter as its canonical export while continuing to accept existing JSON manifests?
rationale: The code appears internally coherent, but choosing a canonical package filename and serialization establishes a public ecosystem contract that cannot be inferred from tests while the linked RFC remains open.

options.title: Adopt CLAW.md canonically
options.body: Approve `CLAW.md` as the generated format, retain JSON reads, and land this slice after its dependent lifecycle stack.

options.title: Keep JSON canonical
options.body: Allow `CLAW.md` as an additional readable source but continue exporting `openclaw.claw.json` until the broader specification is settled.

options.title: Wait for the RFC
options.body: Pause this slice until the linked Claws RFC establishes the cross-harness manifest contract and landing order.

recommendation.title: Adopt CLAW.md canonically
recommendation.body: Approve `CLAW.md` as the generated format, retain JSON reads, and land this slice after its dependent lifecycle stack.
